paragraphs: Rafram. R' Abbahu, Rav Shmuel’s father, was among Rafram’s chief expounders (Hullin 49a). He compelled Rav Ashi: Rashi explains, surrounded him with proofs, Ketubbot 86a. In Bava Kamma 98b Rashi explains that Rav Ashi burned a document in his youth, and he compelled him to pay; see Taz, Orah Hayyim, end of section 343. At the end of Keritot 14a, the discussion dismisses Rafram’s inference as spurious. Bekhorot 36b: Rafram in Pumbedita had a firstborn animal and gave it to a priest without a blemish; the priest inflicted a blemish on it. One day Rafram's eyesight was weak, and the priest brought the firstborn before him, thinking he would not recognize it. He said, ‘Was it not I who gave it to you?’ He disagrees with Rav Aha: Yevamot 37a. Rafram, Ravina, and Rav Natan (see there).
